summary: Hang glider reported missing in the Marble area; West Elk SAR located him ~3:12 a.m. the next morning, stayed overnight, and he was airlifted out the next day with suspected broken ribs, leg, and ankle.
responding_agency: West Elk Search and Rescue; Gunnison County Sheriff's Office (North District)
notes: GCSO weekly press release, parent-opened 2026-09-19; located 2018-09-23 ~3:12 a.m., airlifted 2018-09-23.
